en-US.title: Charades: Make Your Own Decks
en-US.subtitle: Offline party game for friends
en-US.promoText: Phone on your forehead. Your friends yell clues. Banned-words mode, three-round mode, chaos twists and 17 free decks. No ads, no account, no Wi-Fi needed.
en-US.description:
Hold the phone to your forehead. A word pops up that everyone can see except you. Your friends yell clues, act it out, hum it — anything but say the word — and you get as many as you can before time's up.

ONE TAP TO PLAY
Swipe through decks like lenses and hit the button. You're playing, for as long as you like. Peek at a deck's cards first, star your favourites so they come first, and set up teams and house rules when you want them.

17 FREE DECKS, 1,700 CARDS
Celebrities, Sports, Movie & TV Quotes, Gen Z Slang, Viral Internet, Reality TV, Music Icons, Anime & Gaming, 2010s Throwback, Emoji Charades and more, with 100 cards in every deck. Hide the cards you don't want and add your own to any of them. No ads. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No account.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
Classic. Banned Words, where the room can't say the words under the card. And 3 Rounds: the same cards come back three times — describe it, then one word, then act it out. It gets funnier every round.

CHAOS AND FORFEITS
Turn on chaos for a wild rule some rounds: accents only, hum it, double points, speed round. Turn on forfeits and last place gets a dare.

MAKE YOUR OWN
Answer five questions about your friend group and get a deck only you can play. Add photos of faces to cards. Paste a whole list.

SHARE IN SECONDS
Show a code and the whole room has your deck. AirDrop it and it opens straight in Charades. Big decks travel as a quick flip of codes. Nothing gets uploaded anywhere.

YOUR NIGHT, WRAPPED
The MVP, the fastest guess, the card nobody could get — one image to post. Keep a friends leaderboard, and keep your streak alive.

CONTROLS THAT WORK
Tip the phone down if you got it, up to pass. Or swipe up and down anywhere, or tap. Upright or sideways, it plays the way you hold it. A ding for every card you get, a buzzer when time's up.

KEEP IT GOING
Endless games for long lines and longer nights. Someone miles ahead? Start over in a tap. Bored of a deck? Swap it mid-game and the scores carry on.

DAY OR NIGHT
A dark look for parties and a light one you can read in the sun.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Charades works fully offline — on a plane, at a cabin, in a basement with no signal — and collects nothing. Your decks, photos, games and streak stay on your phone.
en-US.releaseNotes: Tilt that just works: hold the phone however feels natural and nod. Pause any time, change the round length in a tap, and turn the phone mid-game without missing a card. Lighter and simpler: no microphone, no notifications, everything on your phone.
